_rules: One entry per YouTube video, written only from the creator's own description. 'onSite' = the main sound was recorded at this place (allows 'I recorded this at ...'). 'made' says plainly what is real and what was added; every caption carries it. 'hooks' are the first-second lines a Reel opens on, each true for this video. Leave a video out (or set hold) when a fact is unknown.
